variety_description: Late maturity, medium height, short bold grain, high yielding widely adaptable variety grown in India under rainfed lowland conditions. Developed by NRRI and released in 2009 for cultivation in the states of Eastern India. Tolerant to complete submergence up to 15-17 days. Highly adaptable to flood-prone shallow lowlands. Excellent tillering. Low nitrogen responsive.Tolerant to low soil phosphorus levels. Excellent grain and eating quality with a low glycemic index.
